package.name: curobo_task_constructor
package.description: An open MoveIt Task Constructor equivalent for cuRobo: a stage/container framework (generators / propagators / connectors composed into serial, alternatives, fallbacks and independent containers) with cuRobo's batched GPU solve as the execution substrate. Task graphs are declared as StageSpec trees referencing stage types through an open STAGE_REGISTRY — adding a capability is writing a Stage subclass, never editing an enum or the executor. The action server at /curobo_task_constructor/task fronts the MTC Task::init()/plan()/execute() lifecycle and publishes per-attempt introspection (TaskDescription / SolutionInfo / StageStatistics) for the companion rviz panel.
